name: Kraken
summary: A colossal sea monster that grapples with tentacles, flings and swallows foes, calls lightning, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The kraken can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The kraken makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Fling, Lightning Strike, or Swallow.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.onHit: The target has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=20}) from one of ten tentacles, and it has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Fling
actions.text: The kraken throws a Large or smaller creature {ref:condition/grappled} by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn't in the air. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* {dc:str}, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. *Failure:* {dmg:4d8:bludgeoning}, and the target has the {ref:condition/prone} condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

save.targets: one creature the kraken can see within 120 feet

actions.name: Swallow

save.targets: one creature Grappled by the kraken (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time)

actions.onFailure: If the target is Large or smaller, it is swallowed and no longer {ref:condition/grappled}. A swallowed creature has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes {dmg:7d6:acid} at the start of each of its turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a {dc:str} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the kraken with the {ref:condition/prone} condition. If the kraken dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting {ref:condition/prone}.

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the kraken can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The kraken regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Toxic Ink

save.targets: each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the kraken while it is underwater

items.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/blinded} and {ref:condition/poisoned} conditions until the end of the kraken's next turn. The kraken then moves up to its {ref:glossary/speed}.
items.onFailureOrSuccess: The kraken can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
